title: 第六章 禁止伤害店长，违者，死！-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》
content:
一直到第七天，也就是任务的最后一天，也依旧没有一个客人敢走进这里，到是周围的窥视者越来越多了，甚至有不少人尝试靠近，但是在距离游戏商店十几米的地方又退却了。

    那些人来回试探了好几次，胆子也是一次比一次大。

    爻雪见状，觉得世间应该差不多了，不过这最后一步，还需要她推一下才行，毕竟这是她绑定系统之后的第一个任务，虽然完不成人不会有什么惩罚，但若是失败了，岂不是显得系统选人的眼光不怎么样，连新手任务都完不成，又怎么去完成之后的任务呢。

    这样想着，爻雪开始将大门打开，然后再休息区煮起了火锅，一时之间，麻辣火锅那种霸道的味道瞬间充斥在这整个空间之中，然后顺着敞开的大门飘向了外面。

    外面那些窥视的人在问道这霸道的香气之后，损失就坐不住了，其中一个身材壮硕的男人目光狠厉的看向那扇敞开的大门，手中握着的撬棍紧了紧，心中像是下定了某种决心，下一秒，就朝着那边走去。

    游戏商店内，爻雪吃着火锅，抬头看向走进来的男人，眼神清澈，脸上带着淡淡的笑，不会显得太冷漠，也不会显得太过激动。

    这表情可是她对着镜子练习了好几天的，为的就是能够让自己显得波澜不惊，应该一种世外高人的感觉，如果不是她现在在吃东西的话，她其实更想要戴上口罩，只留一双眼睛在外面。

    “欢迎光临，本店禁止暴力。”

    爻雪看着手中拿着的沾血的撬棍，脸上的笑容不见，但实际上心里慌得要死。

    系统你可一定要保护好我啊，要不然我做鬼都不会放过你们的。

    男人并没有理会爻雪，在看到她正在吃的火锅之后，心中顿时升起了一股滔天的怒火，我们在外面衣不果腹，你竟然在这里吃火锅。

    这段时间所激烈的压力和愤怒瞬间爆发，他快步朝着爻雪走了过去，手中的撬棍重重落下。

    就在撬棍即将要砸到爻雪的脑袋的时候，异变发生了，男人的身体仿佛被定住了一般，竟然僵在原地一动不动。

    男人惊恐的看着爻雪，声音颤抖道：“你对我干了什么？”

    爻雪歪了歪脑袋，脸上依旧是那种淡淡的笑容，紧接着，脸上的笑容渐渐消失，取而代之的是一双古井无波的眼睛，以及冰冷的语气，“我说过了，本店禁止暴力，以及……禁止伤害店长，违者，死！”

    下一秒，男人的身体直接被一股无形的力量抓到了外面，然后再其他人面前，直接被碾碎了一滩烂泥。

    浓郁的血腥气很快就吸引来了一群变异生物，它们大快朵颐的吃着地上的血肉，吃完之后，它们便再次开始四处寻找猎物，而对于那栋奇怪的建筑，仿佛视若无睹一般。

    其他人在看到这一幕之后，吓得更加不敢靠近了。

    他们虽然没有看清楚刚刚里面到底发生了什么，但是声音他们却是听的清清楚楚，或者说，是里面的那个自称是店长的人故意让他们听见的。

    火锅的香气依旧在他们的鼻尖萦绕，不知道过了多久，终于再次有人坚持不住了，这次是一名短发的女生，在小心的躲过几只在附近徘徊的变异生物之后，她终于踏足了这座神秘的商店内。

content_en:
Until the seventh day, which was the last day of the mission, there was still no customer who dared to walk in here. There were more and more peepers around, and many people even tried to get closer, but retreated ten meters away from the game store.

Those people tried it back and forth several times, becoming more courageous each time.

Seeing this, Yaoxue felt that the world should be almost done, but she still needed to push for this last step. After all, this was her first task after binding to the system. Although there would be no punishment for failing to complete it, if it failed, wouldn't it mean that the system's vision for selecting people was not very good. If it couldn't even complete the novice task, how would it be able to complete the subsequent tasks.

Thinking like this, Yaoxue started to open the door, and then cooked hot pot in the rest area. For a moment, the overbearing smell of spicy hot pot instantly filled the entire space, and then drifted outside along the open door.

外面那些窥视的人在问道这霸道的香气之后，损失就坐不住了，其中一个身材壮硕的男人目光狠厉的看向那扇敞开的大门，手中握着的撬棍紧了紧，心中像是下定了某种决心，下一秒，就朝着那边走去。

In the game store, Yao Xue was eating hot pot and looked up at the man who walked in. His eyes were clear and there was a light smile on his face, which did not appear too cold or too excited.

She had practiced this expression in front of the mirror for several days, in order to make herself look calm and calm, and to have the feeling of being a master of the world. If she hadn't been eating now, she would actually have wanted to wear a mask and leave only a pair of eyes outside.

"Welcome, violence is prohibited in our store."

Yaoxue looked at the bloody crowbar in her hand, the smile on her face disappeared, but in fact she was panicking to death.

System, you must protect me, otherwise I will never let you go.

The man ignored Yao Xue. After seeing the hot pot she was eating, a surge of anger suddenly arose in his heart. We didn't have enough food to eat outside, but you are eating hot pot here.

The intense pressure and anger during this period broke out instantly. He walked quickly towards Yaoxue, and the crowbar in his hand fell heavily.

Just when the crowbar was about to hit Yaoxue's head, something happened. The man's body seemed to be frozen, and he froze in place.

The man looked at Yaoxue in horror and said in a trembling voice: "What did you do to me?"

Yaoxue tilted her head, with the faint smile still on her face. Then, the smile gradually disappeared, replaced by a pair of ancient eyes and a cold tone, "I have said that violence is prohibited in this store, and... it is prohibited to harm the store manager. Violators will die!"

The next second, the man's body was directly grabbed outside by an invisible force, and then was crushed into a puddle of mud in front of others.

The rich smell of blood soon attracted a group of mutated creatures. They feasted on the flesh and blood on the ground. After eating, they began to look for prey again, and seemed to turn a blind eye to the strange building.

After others saw this scene, they were even more frightened and did not dare to get close.

Although they didn’t see clearly what happened inside just now, they heard the sound clearly. In other words, the person inside who claimed to be the store manager deliberately let them hear it.

The aroma of hot pot was still lingering on the tips of their noses. I don’t know how long it took, but someone finally couldn’t hold on anymore. This time it was a girl with short hair. After carefully avoiding several mutated creatures wandering nearby, she finally set foot in this mysterious store.
title_en: Chapter 6 It is forbidden to harm the store manager. Violators will die!- "Apocalyptic Invasion: I am an NPC in the dungeon"
